fields.why: SO-811 Primary Ore Sorter Modbus comms have been upgraded to provide PSD measurements (D10, D50, D90). Displaying and trending them improves visibility of sorter feed size and lets the team monitor crushing circuit performance and ore presentation.
fields.design:
- Modify the SO-811 SCADA faceplate to display D10, D50 and D90
- Add historian tags and trending for the new PSD values
- No control logic changes at this stage
fields.impact: CROs and metallurgists can see and trend SO-811 feed PSD, helping spot screen panel, grizzly and crusher wear.
